about.title: Who we are
about.intro: We are a specialised credit institution. We lend on our own account and study the files that mainstream banks turn away, on the real situation rather than on a score.

sections.heading: Our work
sections.body: Deciding on concrete elements — income, collateral, history — and not on an algorithm. We turn a file refused elsewhere into a qualified and realistic one, or we say so honestly when it is not possible.

sections.heading: Our audience
sections.body: People flagged for credit incidents, self-employed without three sets of accounts, short contracts, seniors, tight business cash flow: profiles often turned away, that we take the time to study.

sections.heading: Our method
sections.body: An honest pre-assessment, a study carried out by someone who explains every criterion to you, a reasoned decision. Every figure is shown before any signature.

meta.title: Our commitments — OrentaLoan
meta.description: Transparency, honesty and a decision on the real situation: the commitments we keep.

commitments.title: Our commitments
commitments.intro: In this market, transparency is our first argument. Here is what we hold to, without exception.
items: No promise of approval: we never guarantee an agreement.
A decision on your real situation, not on an automatic score.
An announced and honoured response time, without artificial urgency.
Figures always indicative and an APR shown before any signature.
Your situation data handled with strict care, and never sold.
